children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Choose local or federated sign-in, diagnose authentication failures, and recover access without locking out every administrator.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Keep one tested administrative recovery path until SSO-only redirects, claims, and role mappings work end to end.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Local accounts use a Gameplane credential; provider buttons delegate password and MFA to the configured identity provider.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Use username or email with the local account password.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Use the correct OIDC provider button for federated accounts.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Do not enforce SSO-only until an administrative provider login is verified.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Generic errors protect account details, so correlate the browser response with API health and provider configuration.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Re-enter the identifier and avoid repeated guesses; a browser already signed in skips the per-username limit (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Verify issuer, redirect URI, client Secret, clock, claims, and mapped role.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: For a loading loop, check session requests, API logs, and database health.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Use self-service recovery only when configured; otherwise an audited local reset signs out all sessions (v0.4.0). Test the effective role privately.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Local → username/email + password; OIDC → provider button

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Failure → API health, redirect, issuer, claims, and rate limits

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Recovery → audited admin reset or bootstrap-admin break-glass; OIDC resets upstream

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
